findings.affected_population: Residents and families whose homes are near the shifted control-line markers; count not reported
findings.affected_system: Residential access, land use, civilian housing and agricultural land near military control line

bounded_discovery_context.specific_reported_development: Local sources said military control markers were moved about 500 meters overnight to locations amid homes east of al-Masdar. The same report described ongoing leveling of farmland and demolitions of evacuated homes in the east of central Gaza.
bounded_discovery_context.why_qualifying: A described shift of markers amid inhabited residential locations and contemporaneous destruction of civilian homes/farmland constitutes documented civilian-impact military activity rather than a bare report of troop movements.
bounded_discovery_context.source_limitations: Single news account republishing Anadolu with unnamed local sources. Exact event date, first-publication time, residents' displacement count, and independent official corroboration are unknown. Requires primary-production deduplication and verification before use. It may have been visible to an intervening watch; connector did not expose branch directory listing.
